INT./EXT. CAR - HIGHWAY - NIGHT
Raju drives.  the radio crackles with static.   Priya stares out the window, silent.

RAJU
(over the noise)
Say something. Anything.

PRIYA
Not now.

INT. KITCHEN
Dishes pile up in the sink. A kettle whistles unattended.

EST. CITY SKYLINE
Wide over a sleeping city, lights flickering off one by one.

RAJU
(V.O.)
I used to think silence meant peace.

EXT PARKING LOT - DUSK
Priya gets out of the car and slams the door.

PRIYA ^
(furious)
I can't do this anymore.

RAJU ^
Wait, please.

CUT TO:

INT. HOSPITAL HALLWAY - CONTINUOUS
Fluorescent lights hum overhead. Raju runs down the corridor.
